title: Federal Rule 22 — interpleader
summary: Interpleader allows a stakeholder facing competing demands for the same property or obligation to bring the claimants into one proceeding. It protects against inconsistent obligations while providing a process to decide entitlement.

sections.Role in the course: Interpleader allows a stakeholder facing competing demands for the same property or obligation to bring the claimants into one proceeding. It protects against inconsistent obligations while providing a process to decide entitlement.
sections.What to examine: Identify the fund or obligation, the competing claimants, and whether the stakeholder faces double payment or multiple liability. Choose between the applicable state procedure, Federal Rule 22, and statutory interpleader, then check that route’s jurisdiction and service requirements.
